description: Field list for the AI Search index of report chunks. The index NAME is not stored here; it comes from AZURE_SEARCH_INDEX_NAME. python-worker creates the index from this file (FAI-010), and node-api queries using the same field names (FAI-024). A value of the form ${VAR} must be replaced with that environment variable from shared/.env.example.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Deterministic chunk ID: '<document_id>_<chunk_index>'. Re-ingesting a document overwrites its chunks.

fields.name: document_id
fields.description: Same as document_id in the ingestion queue message.

fields.name: section
fields.description: Report section heading the chunk belongs to.

fields.name: page
fields.description: 1-based PDF page where the chunk starts. Used for citations.

fields.name: chunk_index
fields.description: 0-based position of the chunk within the document.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Chunk text (markdown; tables are kept whole).

fields.name: content_vector
fields.description: Embedding of content, made with the AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_DEPLOYMENT deployment.
